verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev provides a documented SDK (tasks, triggering, retries, queues), a full CLI (dev/deploy commands, project scaffolding), a Management API with authentication for building custom integrations, and build extensions to hook into the build system — all backed by first-party docs and corroborated by hands-on community use (integrating into Node/NestJS apps, custom queue logic, self-hosting). Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probed and 404) and stronger independent verification of the Management API/connector-building workflow beyond docs.
